answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: 1-in-7 jury seats reserved for the newest establishment. Remember that the wharf is where the cost shows up, and cost is the only honest signal. The distinction matters: a lagoon looks still and is fed by hidden channels. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: 1 shared funding source is enough to flag a whole cohort. Which is only to say that a farm can forge the label but not the horizon.
